context: Two friends chat about a day trip
purpose: Teach: 亀/坪/大橋/小山/舟/出掛け/手持ち/不愉快

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、亀公園に行ってきた。
lines.en: I went to Turtle Park yesterday.
lines.style: Warm opening, genuine pleasure in the memory. Easy pace, slight lift on the place name. Present and unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 坪庭風のカフェも、その近くだよね。
lines.en: There's that tsubo-garden-style café nearby, isn't there?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, the kind that invites sharing. Soft intonation, leaning in slightly. A question that means you're listening.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。大橋を渡って、向こうの小山まで歩いたの。
lines.en: Yeah. Crossed the big bridge and walked out to the little hill on the other side.
lines.style: Becoming more animated, the picture expanding as she speaks. Slight acceleration on the path description. Her body opens up.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Were there boats out on the river?
lines.style: Genuine, interested follow-up. Pace steady, intimate. Not rushing — wanting the details of her day.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、ちょうど空いてた。気持ちよく出掛けた一日。
lines.en: Yeah, they were running. It was just a really good day out.
lines.style: Contentment in the voice, unforced. Slight glow of satisfaction. Warm but not effusive. The comfort of sharing something good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Did your money hold out okay?
lines.style: Gentle, practical concern beneath the surface. Not prying — the kind of care that checks in without making it a big thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ぎりぎり。隣の客がうるさくて、ちょっと不愉快だったけど、それ以外は最高。
lines.en: Just barely made it. There was a loud guy next to us that kind of spoiled the moment, but otherwise it was perfect.
lines.style: Slight wry edge on the complaint — not dwelling. Quick recovery, genuine warmth returning. The honesty of someone secure enough to admit the flaw and move past it.
